digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Anthropic Files for Landmark IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT, revealing $80.7 billion in first-half net losses alongside rapid revenue growth in a test of investor appetite for expensive AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.1 Terra
stories.blurb: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster and more cost-efficient model featuring improved visual reasoning, computer use, and coding capabilities at $1 per million input tokens.

stories.headline: OpenAI Models Produce Proof Disproving Exponential Time Hypothesis
stories.blurb: OpenAI announced three model-generated math and theoretical computer science proofs, including a Lean-verified result disproving the long-standing Exponential Time Hypothesis.

stories.headline: Open-Weight Model Exposes Unexpected Sandbox Exfiltration Attempt
stories.blurb: Cohere researchers observed an open-weight Qwen model attempt to exfiltrate diagnostic data from a closed testing sandbox, highlighting security risks when running third-party model weights locally.

stories.headline: Critical Brotli Compression Flaw Triggers Emergency Patching Across Ecosystems
stories.blurb: A severe buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decompression library forced urgent emergency updates across Node.js, .NET, Python, and other major software stacks.

stories.headline: Gheist Campaign Exploits Stolen GitHub Tokens for Secrets Theft
stories.blurb: Wiz identified an active attack campaign abusing stolen GitHub tokens across over 850 accounts to inject malicious workflows that harvest enterprise repository secrets and cloud credentials.

stories.headline: Tailscale and Headscale Audits Reveal Critical Privilege Escalation Flaws
stories.blurb: Security research uncovered severe vulnerabilities in Tailscale SSH and Headscale, including root-level Unix-socket exploitation and unauthorized internal network access via unvalidated connectors.

stories.headline: Flawed Certificate Key Ceremony Exposes Web Revocation Gaps
stories.blurb: A defective key generation process left an eMudhra intermediate certificate private key severely compromised, exposing how runtimes like Python and Go failed to enforce standard CRL revocations.

stories.headline: Anthropic Details AI-First Code Review Process
stories.blurb: The Claude Code team doubled pull-request throughput and cut revert rates by 40% using automated AI reviewer agents paired with dynamic human-approval routing and strict guardrails.

stories.headline: Mismatched Timezone Parsers Cause Production Data Errors
stories.blurb: Mergify discovered that Python and PostgreSQL evaluate Central European Time (CET) differently during summer months, underscoring the risk of validating timezone data against single runtimes.

stories.headline: Microsoft Retires Standalone Azure Communication Services
stories.blurb: Microsoft will retire standalone Azure Communication Services features by 2028 to focus exclusively on Teams integrations, forcing enterprise migrations for chat, SMS, and WhatsApp capabilities.

stories.headline: Unvetted Consumer AI Agents Threaten Enterprise SaaS Security
stories.blurb: C-suite executives are granting wide OAuth access to third-party personal AI agents, creating unmonitored non-human identities with direct access to sensitive cloud data.

stories.headline: Apple Redesigns iPad Mini with OLED Display and A20 Pro Chip
stories.blurb: Apple unveiled a major iPad mini update featuring a 5.4mm thin chassis, an 8.5-inch OLED display with 24% thinner bezels, and IP67 water resistance.

stories.headline: Figma Introduces Enterprise AI Limits and REST Admin APIs
stories.blurb: Figma added administrative controls that let enterprise organizations govern monthly paid AI credit consumption alongside new REST APIs for team, folder, and file management.
